title: Exploring IRGs as a Biomarker of Pulmonary Hypertension Using Multiple Machine Learning Algorithms
summary: Animal experiments validate machine-learning-selected pulmonary-hypertension biomarkers. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Department of Clinical Laboratory Center, Beijing Anzhen Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing 100029, China

evidence.tested: Animal experiments validate machine-learning-selected pulmonary-hypertension biomarkers. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish improved patient outcomes or generalization beyond the evaluated setting.
